name: MonarchVersionHistoryPanel
title: VersionHistoryPanel
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of androidx.compose.material3.ListItem rows, androidx.compose.material3.SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow, androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog and androidx.activity.compose.BackHandler, composing MonarchDiffViewer, MonarchTextField, MonarchButton, MonarchAvatar, MonarchBadge, MonarchSkeleton and MonarchEmptyState; android.icu.text.RelativeDateTimeFormatter and DateFormat for the times
summary: The version history of a document or record: the saved versions, what changed between a version and now, its full text, and restore behind a confirmation.
whenToUse: In a full-height ModalBottomSheet or a pane beside a document or record, so people can see earlier versions, compare one with the content now, restore it and save a named version.
whenNotToUse: For the versions an AI model wrote of one artifact, use MonarchAiArtifactVersions. For a log of who did what, use MonarchActivityTimeline. To compare two texts without a history, use MonarchDiffViewer.
api: @Composable fun MonarchVersionHistoryPanel(versions: List<MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion>, selection: String?, onSelectionChange: (String?) -> Unit, currentLines: List<String>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, selectedLines: List<String>? = null, currentId: String? = null, loading: Boolean = false, now: Long? = null, locale: Locale? = null, timeZone: String? = null, onSaveVersion: (suspend (note: String) -> Unit)? = null, onRestore: (suspend (id: String) -> Unit)? = null, onClose: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchVersionHistoryPanelLabels = MonarchVersionHistoryPanelLabels())
data class MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion(id: String, date: Long, authorName: String, authorImage: Painter? = null, note: String? = null, automatic: Boolean = false)

class MonarchVersionHistoryPanelLabels(close: String? = null, back: String? = null, versions: String? = null, noteLabel: String? = null, notePlaceholder: String? = null, save: String? = null, saved: String? = null, saveFailed: String? = null, empty: String? = null, current: String? = null, automatic: String? = null, changes: String? = null, fullText: String? = null, now: String? = null, identical: String? = null, restore: String? = null, restoreTitle: String? = null, restoreDescription: String? = null, restoreConfirm: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, restored: String? = null, restoreFailed: String? = null, loading: String? = null, diff: MonarchDiffViewerLabels = MonarchDiffViewerLabels())

options.name: versions
options.description: The saved versions, newest first: id, date (epoch milliseconds), author name and picture, name and whether it was saved automatically.

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the version on screen, or null for the list. It is the navigation state: the Versions button and the system back gesture call onSelectionChange(null).

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the version to open, or null to return to the list. Load the version's lines here.

options.name: currentLines
options.description: The content now, one entry per block or paragraph.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the panel. Give it a bounded height: the list and the diff are lazy.

options.name: title
options.description: The title of the list. "History" when null.

options.name: selectedLines
options.description: The selected version's content. Placeholders show while it is null.

options.name: currentId
options.description: The version that matches the content now, marked Current and without Restore. The newest when null.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows placeholder rows while the list loads.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for relative times, in epoch milliseconds. null follows the clock, refreshed every minute.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of times and dates. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The zone of the date written on a version's screen. An IANA id such as Europe/Berlin; null, or an id the device does not know, is the device's zone.

options.name: onSaveVersion
options.description: Shows a name field and Save version above the list. Receives the trimmed name, at most 200 characters. Throw to show the error under the field.

options.name: onRestore
options.description: Shows Restore this version on versions other than the current one, behind a confirmation. Throw to keep the screen with the error; on success the panel returns to the list.

options.name: onClose
options.description: Shows a Close button at the end of the header.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, and the diff's strings in diff.

states.name: list
states.description: The versions, each with an avatar, a relative time, the author and the name; the current one has an info Current badge.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small empty state: "No versions yet. Save one to mark this moment."

states.name: saving
states.description: Save version shows progress and the name field is disabled; an error shows under the field and is announced.

states.name: version, loading
states.description: The version's screen shows placeholder lines until selectedLines arrives.

states.name: changes
states.description: A MonarchDiffViewer from the version to now, with totals and folded unchanged runs, or "This version is identical to the current one."

states.name: restoring
states.description: Restore this version shows progress after the confirmation; an error shows above it and is announced.

appearance: No surface of its own: it takes the sheet's or pane's background. The title in the subheading style and default text, rows separated by subtle dividers with the time in the strong body style and the author line in muted caption text, the Current badge in the info tone, ghost buttons for Versions and Close, the Material 3 segmented control in the theme's colors, the diff viewer's added and removed colors with signs, a primary Restore button and errors in the strong danger color. The same roles in dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web is an aside panel that swaps its list for a detail view with tabs. On Android, as on iOS, it is the phone's list and detail pattern: the app presents it in a full-height ModalBottomSheet or a pane, the selection is the navigation state, the system back gesture (BackHandler) and a Versions button return to the list, a Material 3 segmented control switches Changes and Full text, and restore is confirmed in a Material 3 AlertDialog. Names follow iOS; the Binding<String?> selection is selection with onSelectionChange, isLoading is loading, currentID is currentId, onSaveVersion and onRestore are suspending functions (Compose's equivalent of async throws), and the author's picture is authorImage: Painter? because Monarch loads no images (the iOS authorURL is not offered). Monarch bundles no icons, so Back and Close are text buttons. The web's own line diff is MonarchDiffViewer, which word-highlights changed lines; it is lazy, so the panel needs a bounded height. Relative times are written by android.icu.text.RelativeDateTimeFormatter and refresh every minute without now; the absolute date is written on the version's screen instead of a tooltip.
accessibility: The list title and the version's title (its relative time) are headings.
Each version is one button read as the relative time, the author and the version's name or "Saved automatically"; the current one has the state "Current". Rows keep a 48dp touch target.
Avatars are decorative, because the author's name is written beside them.
On the version's screen the author line and the date are read as one element.
The Versions button is named "Back to versions"; the system back gesture does the same.
The diff is read as described for MonarchDiffViewer: each line after "Added" or "Removed".
"Version saved", "Version restored" and the save and restore errors are announced through a polite live region that is always present.
Restore is behind a Material 3 dialog with Restore and Cancel.
edgeCases: A selection that is not one of the versions shows the list.
Without onRestore, and on the current version, there is no Restore.
An empty or blank name saves an unnamed version; names are cut at 200 characters.
A thrown error without a message shows the built-in failure text; a cancellation is not shown as an error.

examples.title: Browse, compare, save and restore
examples.template:
MonarchVersionHistoryPanel(
    versions = versions,
    selection = selection,
    onSelectionChange = { selection = it },
    currentLines = content[{{versions.0.id}}].orEmpty(),
    modifier = Modifier
        .height(MonarchTheme.spacing.space24 * 4)
        .border(MonarchTheme.spacing.px, MonarchTheme.colors.borderSubtle, MonarchTheme.shapes.lg),
    title = {{title}},
    selectedLines = selection?.let { content[it] },
    currentId = {{versions.0.id}},
    now = now,
    onSaveVersion = { },
    onRestore = { },
    onClose = { selection = null },
    labels = MonarchVersionHistoryPanelLabels(automatic = "auto"),
    closeIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null, size = MonarchIconSize.Sm) },
)
examples.setupTemplate:
var selection by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
val content = mapOf(
    {{versions.0.id}} to listOf({{versions.0.lines.0}}, {{versions.0.lines.1}}, {{versions.0.lines.2}}, {{versions.0.lines.3}}, {{versions.0.lines.4}}),
    {{versions.1.id}} to listOf({{versions.1.lines.0}}, {{versions.1.lines.1}}, {{versions.1.lines.2}}, {{versions.1.lines.3}}),
    {{versions.2.id}} to listOf({{versions.2.lines.0}}, {{versions.2.lines.1}}, {{versions.2.lines.2}}),
    {{versions.3.id}} to listOf({{versions.3.lines.0}}, {{versions.3.lines.1}}),
)
val versions = listOf(
    MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion({{versions.0.id}}, now - {{versions.0.ageSeconds}} * 1_000L, {{versions.0.author}}),
    MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion({{versions.1.id}}, now - {{versions.1.ageSeconds}} * 1_000L, {{versions.1.author}}, note = {{versions.1.note}}),
    MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion({{versions.2.id}}, now - {{versions.2.ageSeconds}} * 1_000L, {{versions.2.author}}, automatic = {{versions.2.automatic}}),
    MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion({{versions.3.id}}, now - {{versions.3.ageSeconds}} * 1_000L, {{versions.3.author}}, note = {{versions.3.note}}),
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web label of this button joins its visible text and hidden text with no separator; on Android the button is named with a sentence for TalkBack and its visible text is shown as it is.
parityExceptions.convention: a control is named in a sentence, not by concatenated visible text (Material accessibility)
